page_title: EMP 1-1 LEC | Empoli v Lecce 11/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+3' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
90' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

89' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Andrea Colombo with no other option than to blow for a foul.
87' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
86' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Ylber Ramadani is replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
85' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
82' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
82' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) makes a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
80' Aurelio Andreazzoli has decided to make a change. Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) replaces Viktor Kovalenko.
80' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Matteo Cancellieri.

78' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) has a great opportunity but fails to score. The ball from the corner falls to him to unleash a shot towards the top of the net, but the keeper pulls off a great save to deny him.
78' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Empoli.
75' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
71' 1 - 1 Here is an example of luck not being on your side. Hamza Rafia (Lecce) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him, it's into his own goal!
70' Substitution. Alexis Blin (Lecce) in, Joan Gonzalez out.
70' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:5.
68' Roberto D'Aversa is stunned as referee Andrea Colombo shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
68' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
67' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for an infringement.
64' 0 - 1 Lameck Banda (Lecce) unleashed a missile shot that goes inside the middle of the net. What a splendid goal!
63' The substitution is prepared. Razvan Marin (Empoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Youssef Maleh.
63' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hamza Rafia (Lecce) replacing Remi Oudin.
60' Roberto Piccoli goes off the pitch and Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) comes on.
57' Empoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
56' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.

55' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
53' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
53' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
52' The game is interrupted now, Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' It must be a yellow card. It is. Alberto Grassi (Empoli) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
50' Lameck Banda (Lecce) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Colombo interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
49' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
48' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
47' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes low to the middle of the target, but Wladimiro Falcone keeps it out.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Roberto D'Aversa gives a chance to Antonino Gallo and Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) is off.
46' Aurelio Andreazzoli has made a change at the break. Tyronne Ebuehi has come on in place of Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Andrea Colombo has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

45+2' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Empoli.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

44' What a wasted opportunity by Lameck Banda (Lecce)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Etrit Berisha makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
42' Stiven Shpendi (Empoli) is penalised for a foul. Andrea Colombo had a clear view and blows his whistle.
41' Aurelio Andreazzoli is forced to make a change. Francesco Caputo is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Stiven Shpendi (Empoli).
41' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
40' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
38' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Nicola Sansone (Lecce) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
38' The ball is cleared after Nicola Sansone (Lecce) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
37' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
36' 5:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
35' Remi Oudin (Lecce) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
34' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
34' A lofted cross from Lameck Banda (Lecce) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
34' Lecce are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
29' The Empoli players are exchanging some short passes.
28' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.

26' A tremendous drive by Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Wladimiro Falcone makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Empoli.
25' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
23' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
22' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
18' Lecce control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
17' Lameck Banda (Lecce) serves up a nice cross, but Etrit Berisha punches the ball away.
17' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andrea Colombo no option but to blow his whistle.

15' The corner lands on the head of Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) in the middle of the box and he tries to guide his header into the far right corner, but it's misjudged and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
15' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
15' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Empoli will have an opportunity.
14' Lameck Banda (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation.
13' The corner from Remi Oudin (Lecce) is cleared away by the defence.

13' Lameck Banda (Lecce) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Lecce force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
11' Nicola Sansone (Lecce) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
9' Great teamplay by Empoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' A quickly taken corner by Lecce.

8' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the goal, but Etrit Berisha keeps it out. The ball goes out of play. Lecce are awarded a corner kick.
7' Andrea Colombo blows for a foul after Youssef Maleh (Empoli) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
6' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
6' Simone Bastoni (Empoli) takes a direct free kick.
4' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
3' Andrea Colombo has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).
3' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Simone Bastoni (Empoli).
1' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo was nominated as the referee for this game.
